claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: 16,16-dimethylprostaglandin E2 is a stable PGE2 analog that acts as an EP receptor agonist; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, with any antiproliferative effect being weak and mediated by cAMP/EP receptor signaling rather than a cytotoxic mechanism.
